title: 第二章  不想退婚的未婚妻
content_zh:
在李洛的记忆中，他第一次见到姜青娥，应该是他三岁左右的时候。
那一次，他的父母似乎出了一趟很远的门，回来后，身边就带着当时约莫五岁左右的姜青娥。
后来，他们将姜青娥收为了弟子。
从这个角度来说，李洛与姜青娥算得上是实打实的青梅竹马，而父母对她也是极为的喜爱。
不过李洛与姜青娥幼时的关系，却是颇为的微妙，因为姜青娥自小就太出色了，再加上她大了李洛两岁，小时的诸多争执，最终都是以李洛被姜青娥冷淡的按在地上暴锤一顿而结束。
简直就是噩梦啊。
而姜青娥之所以会变成他的未婚妻，据说是在她十岁左右的时候，那一次老爹喝多了酒，说如果小娥儿是我家的媳妇，那该多好啊。
然后第二天，十岁的姜青娥自己手写了一份婚约，交给了瞠目结舌的老爹。
那一次，老爹被赶回家的老娘差点捶傻了。
最重要的是，还连累得在一旁乐呵呵看戏的他，也被他娘怒气冲冲的揍了一顿。
之后老娘让姜青娥将婚约收回去，但谁都没想到她展现出了让人无奈的执拗，她只是静静的跪在老爹老娘面前。
最终，无可奈何的爹娘只得由着她，但那婚约，则是被他们收起，然后再不提起，犹如当其不存在一般。
此事渐渐随着时间过去，似乎也就没了声息，包括连李洛自己都是遗忘了此事。
但就在前些年姜青娥在南风学府时，因为一个追求者太过锲而不舍以及疯狂，最终她直接开口，公开了她与李洛已有婚约。
此事在当时所引发的轰动，可谓是震撼了整个天蜀郡。
也亏得当时的李洛还没进入南风学府，不然怕真是会被群起而攻之，但即便此事已过去几年时间，那所带来的余波，还是让得如今身在南风学府的李洛深刻的感觉到了姜青娥的魅力。
“老爹，你可真是坑儿子啊。”李洛心中暗叹一声。
“我说李洛，你每天在这里停留，是不是很享受其他人的那种羡慕目光啊？”而就在李洛心中叹息时，突然有着一道女孩声音在身后响起。
李洛转过头，只见得在其身后，立着一名容颜娇俏的少女，少女长发齐腰，颜值虽然比不上姜青娥，但也是一个美人胚子，贴身的校服，包裹着初具规模的娇躯，颇有起伏。
而此时，那少女正双臂抱胸，目光有些讥诮的望着李洛。

不过面对着她的目光，李洛神色倒是颇为的平静，眼前的少女，名为蒂法晴，是一院中的学员，在这南风学府中也算是一朵金花，同时她还出自天蜀郡三大家族的蒂法家族。
这蒂法晴与李洛倒没有什么恩怨，但是，她是姜青娥的铁杆拥趸，而且还是极其疯狂以及失去理智的那一种。
在她的眼中，姜青娥宛如天上谪仙般完美无缺，这世间的任何男人都配不上她，这其中当然也包括了李洛。
即便蒂法晴也承认李洛这皮囊是顶尖级别，但她却觉得，只看外貌实在是过于的肤浅。
姜青娥这般人儿，必须那里外都是人中之龙者，方才能够匹配。
而李洛借助着其父母的优势，以不知道什么手段获得了与姜青娥的婚约，这在蒂法晴看来，简直就是对她心中女神的侮辱。
所以，自从李洛进入到南风学府后，只要遇见这蒂法晴，必然会被迎面一通嘲讽，然后就是那孜孜不倦的一句质问。
“李洛，你什么时候解除姜学姐的婚约？”
不出意料的听到这句被重复了不知道多少遍的质问，就连李洛都是忍不住的揉了揉眉心，没好气的道：“关你屁事。”
然后转身就走。
蒂法晴见状，俏脸上顿时有怒气涌现，不依不饶的跟了上来，道：“李洛，你就这么想癞蛤蟆吃天鹅肉吗？”
不过李洛依旧充耳不闻，理也不理，倒是将她气得脸色铁青，旋即她快步跟上，道：“李洛，如果你不解除婚约，麻烦的只会是你，姜学姐越是优秀出色，你的麻烦就会越大，你父母失踪数年，连你们洛岚府如今都是风雨飘摇，所以你这个少府主身份，可没什么震慑力。”
“你根本不知道如今的大夏国，有多少背景强大，天赋卓绝的年轻天骄倾慕于姜学姐。”
“你不能因为你父母对姜学姐有恩，就要她以这种方式来回报你！”
“李洛，如果你不解除与姜学姐的婚约，不要说其他地方，光是这南风学府内，都会有人找你麻烦。”
李洛的脚步终于是停了一停，道：“哦？谁要找我麻烦？”
蒂法晴轻哼一声，道：“贝家的贝锟，你应该挺熟悉吧，他已经放过话，说希望你能够不要借助着身份的便利去接近姜学姐，另外，他让你两天后在清风楼聚一聚聊一聊。”
李洛笑道：“当然熟悉，当年他可是很喜欢往我跟前凑的。”
当年他父母尚在时，这天蜀郡内，洛岚府说的话，重量不比总督府低，至于这位贝锟，更是时不时的来寻他，然而谁能想到，数年后洛岚府大变，这曾经很想跟他交朋友的权势子弟，却是率先要找他麻烦？
以前这贝锟最喜欢做的事情就是在那清风楼摆好宴，热情客气的请他前去，如今反而竟然是想要他在那里摆宴相请？这位，还真是够直接的啊。

蒂法晴道：“李洛，你不要觉得人家很可笑，世事本就是如此，你家势大，自然有人捧你，如今你洛岚府失势，别人又凭什么给你面子？毕竟之前那些面子，都是你父母挣来的，又不是你。”
李洛点点头，认同的道：“你这话倒是说得有理。”
人情冷暖世态炎凉，这两年李洛是亲身领教过的。
所以他也没有多说什么，加快步伐对着学府之外而去。
而那蒂法晴则是锲而不舍的跟着，一路魔音灌耳般的喋喋不休，那所有话语的中心思想，都是希望李洛能够还姜青娥一个自由。
李洛知道对付这种人最好的方法就是不搭理，所以他一句话也懒得理会，穿过条条走廊，最终出了学府。
而当其迈出学府时，他突然感觉到了周围的声音都是变得安静了许多，连身旁那如苍蝇般的蒂法晴，都是犹如被捏住了喉咙一般。
李洛转头看了她一眼，然后就发现蒂法晴脸色涨红，眼中满是激动之意的望着学府石梯之下。
李洛若有所悟的顺着看去，就见到了一架车辇停在台阶之前，车辇古色古香，宽敞而不乏贵气，四匹通体暗红而健壮的狮马兽拉着车辇，在那车辇上面，还有着熟悉的徽印，正是洛岚府。
而引得蒂法晴面色涨红以及附近那些学员们也露出激动之色的，当然不会只是洛岚府的车辇，而是在那车辇前，所立着的女孩。
女孩长发随意的束起马尾，面容精致而淡然，在夕阳之下折射着诱人的光泽，她披着湛蓝色的短披风，纤细的长靴，战裙之下，修长笔直的白皙双腿几乎让人口干舌燥。
当然最引人注目的，还是那一双如耀日般璀璨纯净的金色眼瞳。
那是...姜青娥？！
学府外有些骚动与沸腾，不知多少学员眼神激动的望着那道修长倩影，他们没想到今日，竟然能够见到这位自南风学府中走出的传说。
李洛则是在那沸腾与炽热的视线中走下了石梯，来到了姜青娥的面前，有些讶异的道：“青娥姐，你什么时候回的南风城？”
洛岚府虽说是自南风城起家，但在成为大夏国四大府之一后，重心已经转移到了大夏的都城，大夏城。
而姜青娥在进入那座大夏国最顶尖的圣玄星学府后，便也是前往了大夏城，再加上这两年她还要掌控洛岚府，所以很难见到她再回南风城，而李洛，也有许久时间没见到她了。
姜青娥看了李洛一眼，淡淡的道：“明天是你十七岁生日，另外洛岚府明日也有一些重要的事情需要在这里商议。”
“今日刚到南风城，顺道来接你回家。”
她的嗓音极为的好听，冷淡而清脆，如深山中的幽泉击打着玉石般。

李洛点点头，他对于姜青娥这幅态度倒是并不奇怪，因为早就熟悉多年，知道她就是这个性格。
“那走吧。”他说道，姜青娥在南风学府太受欢迎，站在这里简直就是能够感受到四周如刀锋般的视线。
姜青娥螓首微点，不过她没有立即转身，而是将目光投向李洛后面那一脸激动的蒂法晴，道：“你叫做蒂法晴是吧？”
蒂法晴激动的连忙点头，脸色涨红的道：“姜学姐，您竟然还记得我？”
姜青娥平静的道：“我希望你以后不要再骚扰李洛了，否则的话，你那在圣玄星学府中的哥哥，我可能会着重的“照顾”他一下。”
蒂法晴脸上的激动顿时凝固了下来，半晌后，她在姜青娥那一双纯粹的金色眼瞳注视下，只能怯生生的点点头，哪还有先前在李洛面前的半点骄横跋扈。
姜青娥说完，这才转身，湛蓝披风轻扬，与李洛一起进了车辇之中，随后那狮马兽长啸间，踏着烟雾平稳的远去。
而蒂法晴则是目送着车辇而去，许久后，方才揉了揉小脸，满脸的迷醉。
“姜学姐...真的是太酷了，真是爱死了！”
content_en:
In Li Luo's memory, the first time he met Jiang Qing'e was when he was about three years old.
That time, his parents seemed to have traveled far away. When they came back, they took Jiang Qing'e with them, who was about five years old at the time.
Later, they accepted Jiang Qing'e as their disciple.
From this perspective, Li Luo and Jiang Qing'e can be regarded as real childhood sweethearts, and her parents also love her very much.
However, the relationship between Li Luo and Jiang Qing'e when they were young was quite subtle, because Jiang Qing'e had been so outstanding since she was a child, and she was two years older than Li Luo. Many of their childhood disputes ended with Li Luo being coldly pushed to the ground by Jiang Qing'e and violently beaten.
What a nightmare.
The reason why Jiang Qing'e became his fiancée is said to be that when she was about ten years old, her father drank too much and said it would be great if Xiao'e'er was my wife.
Then the next day, ten-year-old Jiang Qing'e wrote a marriage contract in her own hand and handed it to her dumbfounded father.
That time, my father was almost beaten silly by my mother who drove him home.
The most important thing is that he, who was so tired that he was watching the show happily, was angrily beaten by his mother.
Later, my mother asked Jiang Qing'e to take back the engagement, but no one expected that she would show such helpless stubbornness. She just knelt down quietly in front of her father and mother.
In the end, her helpless parents had to let her go, but the engagement was put away by them and never mentioned again, as if it didn't exist.
As time passed, the matter seemed to have disappeared, and even Li Luo himself had forgotten about it.
But just a few years ago, when Jiang Qing'e was at Nanfeng Academy, because a suitor was too persistent and crazy, she finally spoke directly and disclosed that she was engaged to Li Luo.
The sensation caused by this incident at the time can be said to have shocked the entire Tianshu County.
Fortunately, Li Luo had not yet entered Nanfeng Academy at that time, otherwise he would have been attacked by a group of people. However, even though several years had passed since the incident, the aftermath still made Li Luo, who is now at Nanfeng Academy, deeply aware of Jiang Qing'e's charm.
"Dad, you are really cheating on your son." Li Luo sighed inwardly.
"I said Li Luo, when you stay here every day, don't you enjoy the envious looks from other people?" Just as Li Luo sighed in his heart, a girl's voice suddenly sounded from behind him.
Li Luo turned his head and saw a pretty girl standing behind him. The girl's hair was up to her waist. Although her appearance was not as good as Jiang Qing'e's, she was still a beautiful woman. Her figure-hugging school uniform wrapped around her delicate body, which was beginning to take shape.
At this time, the girl was crossing her arms across her chest and looking at Li Luo with a somewhat mocking look.
However, facing her gaze, Li Luo looked quite calm. The girl in front of him, named Tifaqing, was a student in the first academy. She was also considered a golden flower in Nanfeng Academy. At the same time, she also came from the Tifa family, one of the three major families in Tianshu County.
There is no grudge between Ti Faqing and Li Luo, but she is a die-hard supporter of Jiang Qing'e, and she is also extremely crazy and irrational.
In her eyes, Jiang Qing'e was as perfect as an immortal in heaven. No man in the world was worthy of her, including Li Luo of course.
Even Ti Faqing admits that Li Luo's skin is top-notch, but she feels that it is too superficial to only look at appearance.
A person like Jiang Qing'e must be a leader among people both inside and outside her home to be able to match her.
And Li Luo took advantage of his parents to obtain the engagement with Jiang Qing'e through unknown means. In Ti Faqing's view, this was simply an insult to the goddess in her heart.
Therefore, since Li Luo entered Nanfeng Academy, whenever he met Ti Faqing, he would be ridiculed and then questioned tirelessly."Li Luo, when will you terminate Senior Jiang's engagement?"
As expected, hearing this question repeated countless times, even Li Luo couldn't help but rub his eyebrows and said angrily: "It's none of your business."
Then turned around and left.
When Ti Faqing saw this, anger suddenly appeared on her pretty face, and she followed him reluctantly and said, "Li Luo, do you really want toads to eat swan meat?"
However, Li Luo still turned a deaf ear and ignored her, which made her look livid with anger. She quickly followed him and said, "Li Luo, if you don't break off the engagement, you will only be in trouble. The more outstanding Senior Sister Jiang is, the greater your troubles will be. Your parents have been missing for several years, and even your Luo Lan Mansion is now in a state of turmoil, so your status as the Young Master of the Mansion is not a deterrent."
"You have no idea how many young prodigies with strong backgrounds and outstanding talents are admiring Sister Jiang in Daxia Kingdom today."
"You can't ask Senior Jiang to repay you in this way just because your parents are kind to you!"
"Li Luo, if you don't terminate your engagement with Senior Jiang, not to mention other places, there will be people in Nanfeng Academy alone who will cause trouble for you."
Li Luo finally stopped for a moment and said, "Oh? Who wants to cause trouble for me?"
Ti Faqing snorted softly and said: "You should be familiar with Bei Kun from the Bei family. He has already let go and said that he hopes you will not take advantage of your status to get close to Senior Jiang. In addition, he asked you to get together at Qingfeng Building in two days to chat."
Li Luo smiled and said: "Of course I'm familiar with him. He liked to get close to me back then."
When his parents were still alive, the words spoken by the Luo Lan Mansion in Shu County were no less important than those in the Governor's Mansion. As for Bei Kun, he would come to look for him from time to time. However, who would have thought that a few years later, the Luo Lan Mansion would undergo drastic changes, and that this powerful kid who once wanted to make friends with him would be the first to cause trouble for him?
In the past, Bei Kun's favorite thing to do was to prepare a banquet at the Qingfeng Building and invite him there warmly and politely. But now he actually wants him to host a banquet there? This one is really straightforward.
Tifa Qing said: "Li Luo, don't think that people are ridiculous. This is how things are in the world. Your family is powerful, so naturally there will be people who will praise you. Now that your Luolan Mansion has lost power, why should others give you face? After all, all the face you had before was earned by your parents, not you."
Li Luo nodded and said in agreement: "What you said makes sense."
Li Luo has experienced this personally in the past two years.
So he didn't say anything more and walked faster towards the outside of the school.
Nadi Faqing, on the other hand, followed perseveringly, chattering like a demonic voice filling her ears all the way. The central idea of ​​all her words was that she hoped that Li Luo could return Jiang Qing'e's freedom.
Li Luo knew that the best way to deal with such people was to ignore them, so he didn't bother to pay attention to them, walked through the corridors, and finally left the school.
When he stepped out of the school, he suddenly felt that the sounds around him had become much quieter. Even the fly-like Tifa Qing next to him felt as if his throat was being pinched.
Li Luo turned to look at her, and then noticed that Ti Faqing's face was flushed, and her eyes were full of excitement as she looked down the stone stairs of the school.
Li Luoruo looked along with enlightenment and saw a chariot parked in front of the steps. The chariot was antique, spacious and noble. Four dark red and strong lion and horse beasts pulled the chariot. On the chariot, there was a familiar emblem, which was Luo Lan Mansion.
Of course, what caused Tifaqing's face to turn red and the nearby students to express excitement was not just the chariot of the Luo Lan Mansion, but the girl standing in front of the chariot.
The girl's long hair is tied up in a ponytail casually, her face is delicate and indifferent, and it reflects the alluring luster under the setting sun. She is wearing a short blue cape.The wind, the slender boots, and the long, straight white legs under the skirt almost made the mouth go dry.
Of course, the most eye-catching thing is the pair of golden eyes that are as bright and pure as the sun.
That's...Jiang Qing'e? !
There was some commotion and excitement outside the academy. Countless students looked at the slender figure with excited eyes. They did not expect to see this legend who came out of Nanfeng Academy today.
Li Luo walked down the stone stairs with the boiling and blazing eyes, came to Jiang Qing'e, and said with some surprise: "Sister Qing'e, when did you return to Nanfeng City?"
Although Luolan Mansion started from Nanfeng City, after becoming one of the four major mansions of Daxia Kingdom, its focus has shifted to Daxia City, the capital of Daxia.
After Jiang Qing'e entered Daxia Kingdom's top Shengxuanxing Academy, she also went to Daxia City. In addition, she had to control Luo Lan Mansion in the past two years, so it was difficult to see her return to Nanfeng City. Li Luo also hadn't seen her for a long time.
Jiang Qing'e glanced at Li Luo and said calmly: "Tomorrow is your seventeenth birthday. In addition, Luo Lan Mansion also has some important matters that need to be discussed here tomorrow."
"I just arrived in Nanfeng City today. I stopped by to pick you up and take you home."
Her voice is extremely pleasant, cold and crisp, like a deep spring hitting jade in a deep mountain.
Li Luo nodded. He was not surprised by Jiang Qing'e's attitude, because he had known her for many years and knew that she had this character.
"Then let's go." He said. Jiang Qing'e was so popular in Nanfeng Academy. Standing here, she could feel the dagger-like sights around her.
Jiang Qing'e nodded slightly, but she did not turn around immediately. Instead, she cast her gaze at the excited Tifaqing behind Li Luo and said, "Your name is Tifaqing, right?"
Ti Faqing nodded excitedly and said with a flushed face: "Senior Jiang, you actually still remember me?"
Jiang Qing'e said calmly: "I hope you will stop harassing Li Luo in the future. Otherwise, I may "take care" of your brother who is in Shengxuanxing Academy."
The excitement on Ti Faqing's face suddenly solidified. After a while, under the gaze of Jiang Qing'e's pure golden eyes, she could only nod timidly. She was not even a little bit arrogant and domineering in front of Li Luo before.
After Jiang Qing'e finished speaking, she turned around, her azure cloak fluttering slightly, and entered the carriage with Li Luo. Then the lion and horse beast roared and walked away steadily through the smoke.
Tifaqing, on the other hand, watched the carriage go away. After a long time, she rubbed her face with a look of confusion on her face.
"Senior Jiang... she's really cool, I love her so much!"
